labeling_note: SDK repos are model-agnostic; model-, dataset- and experiment-specific criteria are marked N/A.

criteria.rationale: Python project dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml.
uv.lock plus a devcontainer Dockerfile pin the environment.
This is an API SDK, not a dataset or model experiment.
The SDK supports multiple models; it does not own or ship a model card.
Apache-2.0 is the code license; there is no project-owned model license.
The repository has a test suite and CI workflows that provide executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the SDK repository.
Tests, CI workflows and helper scripts are present.
The README mentions API prompt parameters, not a project-owned prompt/template.
The SDK does not ship a fixed sampling configuration for a project-owned model.
The repository is an SDK, not a RAG application with a project-owned index.
Function-calling API support is not the same as a reproducible agent trace.
The SDK does not define a model evaluation dataset or benchmark protocol.
The SDK does not make a project-level inference cost claim.
